background: Morgan Stanley is the holding company of a leading US investment bank whose earnings have shifted toward wealth and investment management alongside institutional securities, with a deposit franchise built on brokerage sweeps.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest at A-, all on a stable outlook, with no move since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 4 Nov 2022. CET1 of 14.9% and LCR of 129% are both in the top quarter of US banks, but leverage of 4.9% is in the bottom quarter, which is the weak spot for a balance sheet built on trading assets. Leverage has fallen 0.6 points and Tier 1 leverage 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2025, while CET1 and LCR have held. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
